text: 34,000 floats, what scale does that expand to. im curious because as it stands the current editor has a terrain size that is what i would say is.... maybe 1/32th of what it will expand to in scale
resolution: Informational — answered the scale question. The 34000-float cap is PER CHUNK (a fixed 120m×120m / 120×120-tile record: header + palettes + binding table + two cell grids); it does not scale with terrain size at all — a bigger map adds more chunks, each with its own pooled buffer. The real scale walls documented for a ~32x world: MAX_PAINT_SLOTS=64 in world_loader.zig (only 64 painted chunks get live render nodes/colliders — first wall, ~0.92 km2 painted, warns LIVE MIRROR FULL; proper fix at that point is camera-radius slot recycling, not a bigger constant), GROUND_POOL=128 drawn chunks/frame (culling keeps this fine), and the chunk address window 153x9 (18.4km x 1.1km strip — MAX_CHUNK_ROW=8 needs a ruling if the world should grow both directions). No code changed.
